items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: Toby Hall is good too, see. ... I think Baby Dots is one of the best drummers I ever played with.

ctx.x: I've heard Celestan several times as band the last few years. Yeah.

Until he died just last December. Yeah, last December they say. And he was very good. He was good. And drummers, coming back to drums. Who was one of the best drummers in the last year? I think Baby Dots is one of the best drummers I ever played with. He gave me more time, a better time, twofold, than any drummer that I played with. See, I played with several drummers. Toby Hall is good too, see. And a minor. But Baby Dots is heavy and strong. Regular, you know. If you lose time on anything that you play in it,…
Maybe you can tell me this. Nobody ever seems to know how it spells name. Was his first name Mac and his last name Murray?
